extDescription.message: Kidhibiti cha manenosiri: ufunguo ni wako tu. Jaza manenosiri na misimbo ya hatua mbili, hifadhi akaunti mpya, unda nenosiri imara.

commandFillLogin.description: Keyboard shortcut description in the browser's shortcut settings.

brandPabbel.description: Brand, small label above the wordmark. Keep as is.

brandVault.description: Product word in the popup wordmark (translate 'Vault' only if Pabbel Vault is known by a local name; usually keep).

signInTitle.description: Sign-in screen headline. Short and warm.

signInBody.message: Ingia kwa akaunti yako ya Pabbel. Kila kitu kwenye vault yako husimbwa kwa njia fiche kwenye kifaa hiki kabla ya kuhifadhiwa.

signInWaiting.description: Sign-in button while the sign-in window is open.

signInFine.message: Hufungua accounts.pabbel.com. Hakuna nenosiri linaloandikwa hapa.
signInFine.description: Small print under the sign-in button.

noVaultTitle.description: Shown when the account has no vault yet.

noVaultBody.message: $EMAIL$ bado haina vault. Iunde kwenye wavuti — inachukua dakika moja tu — kisha urudi hapa.
noVaultBody.description: Body when the account has no vault.

actionSetUpOnWeb.description: Button that opens the web vault.

actionSwitchAccount.description: Sign out and sign in with another account.

unlockPasswordLabel.description: Label/placeholder of the vault password field.

unlockWorking.description: Unlock button while deriving the key.

unlockFine.message: Nenosiri lako la vault kamwe haliondoki kwenye kifaa hiki.
unlockFine.description: Small print under the unlock form.

errorUnsafeKdf.message: Pabbel iliomba mpangilio usio salama wa vault, kwa hiyo nenosiri lako halikutumika. Jaribu tena baadaye.
errorUnsafeKdf.description: Unlock refused: the server sent a key-derivation setting below the safe minimum. The password was never used.

teamRefused.message: "$TEAM$" haikuweza kufunguliwa kwa usalama: ufunguo wake ulioshirikiwa umeshindwa ukaguzi wa usalama. Fungua vault ya wavuti kuona sababu.
teamRefused.description: Shown above the list when a team vault's signed key did not verify (possible tampering or a changed key).

errorUnlock.message: Imeshindwa kufungua kwa sasa. Kagua muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena.

unlockStay.description: Opt-in checkbox on the unlock screen: this browser then opens the vault without the password for 30 days.

unlockStayHint.message: Hakuna nenosiri hapa kwa siku 30. Unaweza kuondoa kivinjari hiki kwenye vault ya wavuti wakati wowote.

unlockTrustExpired.message: Siku 30 za kivinjari hiki zimekwisha. Weka nenosiri lako mara moja ili vault ibaki imefunguliwa.
unlockTrustExpired.description: On the unlock screen when the 30 trusted days ended.

unlockTrustEnded.message: Kivinjari hiki hakiaminiki tena: kiliondolewa, au nenosiri lako la vault lilibadilika. Weka nenosiri lako.
unlockTrustEnded.description: On the unlock screen when the trust was taken away.

errorTrust.message: Imefunguliwa, lakini kivinjari hiki hakikuweza kuaminiwa kwa sasa. Jaribu tena kwenye Mipangilio.
errorTrust.description: Toast after unlocking when trusting the browser failed.

optionsStayHint.message: Hufungua vault bila nenosiri kwa siku 30. Pabbel huhifadhi nusu ya ufunguo na kivinjari hiki nusu nyingine, kwa hiyo hakuna upande unaoweza kuifungua peke yake. Kompyuta hii ikipotea, kiondoe chini ya Vivinjari vinavyoaminika kwenye vault ya wavuti.
optionsStayHint.description: Setting hint; explains the split key.

optionsStayUntil.description: Under the setting while it is on; DATE is a formatted date.

optionsStayLocked.message: Fungua vault kwanza ili kuwasha hii.
optionsStayLocked.description: Under the setting while the vault is locked.

optionsPasswordHint.message: Weka nenosiri jipya la vault. Vifaa vyako vingine vitaliomba, na vivinjari vinavyoaminika lazima viaminiwe upya.

passwordWorking.description: Button while the password is being changed.

errorPassword.message: Imeshindwa kubadilisha nenosiri la vault. Jaribu tena.

menuChangePassword.description: Popup menu item; opens the change-password form in Settings.

errorStaleSession.message: Nenosiri lako la vault lilibadilishwa kwenye kifaa kingine. Funga vault kisha uifungue kwa nenosiri jipya, halafu ujaribu tena.
errorStaleSession.description: When the vault open here still uses a password that was changed elsewhere.

vaultsLabel.description: Accessible label of the vault filter chips.

scopeAll.description: Filter chip: items from every vault.

vaultPersonal.description: Name of the person's own vault.

sectionThisSite.description: Section heading: items that match the open website.

emptyThisSite.message: Bado hakuna kilichohifadhiwa kwa tovuti hii.

emptySearch.message: Hakuna kipengee kinacholingana na utafutaji wako.

emptyVault.message: Vault yako ni tupu. Ongeza maelezo yako ya kwanza ya kuingia.

actionRemoveSite.description: Remove a site from the never-save list.

actionChangeShortcut.description: Open the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

toastPasswordCopied.message: Nenosiri limenakiliwa — litafutwa baada ya sekunde 45

toastGenerated.description: Toast after a generated password was filled into a sign-up form.

errorFill.message: Hakuna cha kujaza kwenye ukurasa huu.

errorLoad.message: Imeshindwa kupakia vault yako. Jaribu tena.

errorSecret.message: Huo hauonekani kama ufunguo wa siri wa hatua mbili au kiungo cha otpauth://.

fieldNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the item name (a fictional company is fine).

fieldNote.description: Field label of a secure note's body.

fieldSecret.message: Ufunguo wa siri au kiungo cha otpauth://
fieldSecret.description: Label of the TOTP secret field.

fieldMoveTo.description: Vault picker when editing; changing it moves the item.

moveHint.message: Kuhamisha husimba upya kipengee kwa ajili ya vault nyingine.

generatorFine.message: Hutengenezwa kwenye kifaa hiki kwa kitengeneza nasibu salama. Herufi zinazofanana (l, 1, O, 0) haziwekwi.

inlineNoCodes.message: Hakuna misimbo ya hatua mbili ya $SITE$.

optionsSignedOutHint.message: Ingia ili kujaza na kuhifadhi manenosiri.

optionsAutoLockHint.message: Baada ya muda huu bila kutumia vault. Vault hujifunga kila mara kivinjari kinapofungwa.

optionsInlineHint.message: Onyesha kitufe cha Pabbel Vault ndani ya sehemu unayoandikia.

optionsSavePromptsHint.message: Uliza baada ya kuingia kwa nenosiri ambalo bado halijahifadhiwa, au lililobadilika.

optionsCopyTotp.message: Nakili msimbo wa hatua mbili baada ya kujaza

optionsCopyTotpHint.message: Maelezo ya kuingia yakiwa na msimbo wa hatua mbili unaolingana, uweke kwenye ubao wa kunakili kwa hatua inayofuata. Hufutwa baada ya sekunde 45.

optionsTypeTotp.message: Andika misimbo ya hatua mbili kiotomatiki

optionsTypeTotpHint.message: Kuingia kukiomba msimbo baada ya nenosiri, msimbo wa hatua mbili unaolingana huandikwa humo. Wewe ndiye unayethibitisha kuingia.
optionsTypeTotpHint.description: Setting hint: the code goes in by itself; the person still confirms the sign-in.

toastCodeFilled.description: After a 2-step code was typed in by itself on a sign-in's code step.

optionsShortcutHint.message: Ctrl+Shift+L hujaza maelezo ya kuingia au msimbo wa ukurasa ulioko.

optionsNeverEmpty.message: Bado hakuna tovuti. Ukichagua "Kamwe kwa tovuti hii" unapoulizwa kuhifadhi, tovuti itaongezwa hapa.

saveTitleFor.message: Ungependa kuhifadhi maelezo yako ya kuingia ya $SITE$?

toastPasswordFilledCode.description: The same, when the 2-step code was also copied.

inlineMaskExisting.message: Barakoa yako ya barua pepe kwa tovuti hii

itemMaskPaused.description: The same line when that mask is paused.

qrScanPage.description: Button in the 2-step form: capture the visible browser tab and look for QR codes in it.

qrPaste.description: Button: paste a screenshot or copied QR image from the clipboard.

qrUpload.description: Button: pick an image file that holds a QR code.

qrHint.message: Changanua msimbo wa QR kwenye ukurasa huu, bandika picha ya skrini (Ctrl+V) au pakia picha. Husomwa kwenye kifaa hiki na haitumwi popote.
qrHint.description: Help text under the three QR buttons. Privacy promise: nothing leaves the device.

qrNone.description: Error: the image has no readable QR code.

qrNotOtp.message: Msimbo huu wa QR si msimbo wa uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili
qrNotOtp.description: Error: a QR code was read but it is not a 2-step verification (otpauth) code.

qrCaptureFail.message: Imeshindwa kunasa ukurasa huu. Bandika picha ya skrini badala yake.
qrCaptureFail.description: Error: the browser refused to capture the page (e.g. a browser-internal page).

qrNoClip.message: Hakuna picha kwenye ubao wa kunakili
qrNoClip.description: Error: the clipboard has no image.

qrPick.message: Msimbo huu una akaunti kadhaa. Chagua ile unayotaka kuongeza sasa; changanua tena kwa zingine.
qrPick.description: Shown when one QR code holds several accounts; the person picks one.

qrScanned.description: Confirmation after a scan; ACCOUNT is issuer and account name, e.g. Example · ada@example.com.

qrDetails.description: Shown only when the code is not the default SHA1 / 6 digits / 30 s. ALGORITHM e.g. SHA256, DIGITS e.g. 8, PERIOD in seconds, e.g. 60.
